CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core.protect_privacy_incident_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Incident event is immutable' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
END;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core.protect_privacy_legal_destruction_package()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' AND current_setting('app.privacy_lifecycle', true) = 'on' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Legal destruction package is immutable' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
END $function$
